customerJourneyStories.summary: Modeled adoption of the product or the organization’s rights-service channel; validate this scenario with representative users.

stages.narrative: Repeated gaps during an internal review make the privacy lead seek a shared way of maintaining records.
A peer DPO or privacy training session introduces PrivacyPerfect and its guided demo.
The lead compares a sample register, assessment depth, contributor usability, exports and legal-content maintenance with current spreadsheets and competing tools.
One department migrates a bounded register and completes a supervised assessment; the lead reconciles the result against source files.
Departments submit changes through the workspace and the lead reviews exceptions as part of a regular governance meeting.
The lead supports renewal when review coverage and traceability improve, and expands only after exportability and contributor effort remain acceptable.
